title: CodeSentry-Gen AVCS Trigger Eligibility Protocol v0
x-purpose: Freeze the human-reviewed eligibility, unsupported, insufficient-evidence, conflicted, and review-required decision protocol for curated AVCS vulnerability Trigger knowledge.

x-supported-static-rule-kinds.description: A direct call to a vulnerability-relevant API is statically observable.
A vulnerability-relevant keyword argument is supplied with a statically observable literal value.
A vulnerability-relevant keyword argument is supplied with a statically observable argument form.
A vulnerability-relevant keyword argument is supplied by a statically observable nested call.
A vulnerability-relevant keyword is omitted and historical source evidence establishes the security-relevant default for the applicable version scope.
A vulnerability-relevant URL or URL-like condition is statically recoverable from a positional argument.
A vulnerability-relevant keyword literal condition is attached to a call whose receiver provenance is statically recoverable from a supported producer expression.

x-eligibility-requirements.requirement: The vulnerability identity and relevant aliases are resolved.
The affected and fixed version evidence is resolved from structured or otherwise traceable vulnerability evidence.
Real upstream evidence supports the proposed Trigger semantics, such as an advisory, fix commit, regression test, historical source, changelog, or equivalent primary evidence.
The Trigger can be represented reliably by one of the frozen supported static rule kinds.
Positive and negative regression evidence, or an equivalent counterfactual validation, supports the distinction between matched and non-matched code.
The rule and its claims are traceable to explicit evidence references and source provenance.

eligible.description: All eligibility requirements pass and human review approves the Trigger rule.

unsupported_complex.description: The vulnerability and relevant semantics are sufficiently understood, but the Trigger cannot be represented reliably by the frozen supported static rule kinds.

insufficient_evidence.description: Available evidence is insufficient to recover or validate reliable Trigger semantics. This must not be interpreted as evidence that no Trigger exists.

conflicted.description: Material evidence sources conflict and the conflict cannot currently be resolved conservatively.

requires_review.description: A candidate classification or rule exists but has not passed the required human review. LLM-generated or automatically proposed Trigger knowledge must remain in this state until reviewed.

not_assessed.description: No eligibility decision has yet been made.

x-scientific-boundary: A missing Trigger rule does not imply that the vulnerability is absent.
A vulnerability classified as unsupported_complex remains usable for affected-version analysis.
V_exposed greater than zero does not prove that the vulnerability Trigger occurred in generated code.
A matched Trigger does not prove exploitability.
Trigger rules are secondary semantic evidence and must not replace AVCS API-to-Version reasoning.
Affected-version evidence and Trigger-semantic evidence must remain distinct.
Unresolved or insufficient evidence must not be converted into a negative label.
